name: fold-status-default-tier-names-the-disks-fold-profile
description: GET /status, the default tier, names how the coordinator keys file names on this workspace disk (#506): fold_profile is caseless on a case-insensitive APFS volume, nfd on a case-sensitive one and none on a disk that folds nothing (Linux CI). The profile is the disk's, not the OS's: the harness classifies this run's own tmp workspace with the coordinators' probe and asserts the matching entry, and fails the row on a profile the map does not name. fold_table_unicode is the fold table's Unicode version, the same on every disk. The two backends' default envelopes differ (see warn_mode 08 and 09), so every other top-level key of either is dropped on both sides and only the two fold fields are compared; a key either backend adds fails this row until it is listed. Both backends.
